detail.longDescription: I am making a simple devvit reddit app to scrape some data, but for some reason when getting to this point after successfully logging and going through 30/31 chunks it just freezes every instance with no error. I couldn't find anything in the docs, reddit, github or stackoverflow that talked about this problem. I also tried to ask Copilot GPT 6.0 astra (through free tier copilot) and they couldn't find anything wrong with my code, itself. I have tried to log so many different things, but it just starts the 31/31 and stops logging anything. This is the last log (there's multiple instances running each sending their logs, and the logs are out of order): TIMEOUT active! Resuming 0s remaining TIMEOUT active! Getting Comments. TIMOUT: 5 SECONDS TIMEOUT active! 29 out of 31 16 out of 31 TIMEOUT active! 30 out of 31 TIMEOUT active! 17 out of 31 TIMEOUT active! <------- Waits here for minutes without doing anything, even though there's a timeout script. No errors whatsoever just stops. I'm running reddit devvit with a simple frontend that is just used for calling the backend. Everything other than the comment fetching works perfectly fine. import express from "express"; import { reddit, createServer, getServerPort, Listing, Post, User, Comment, } from "@devvit/web/server"; import { Network } from "inspector/promises"; function getTopAverage(array: number[], percentile: number, upper: boolean) { if (array.length == 0) {return 0;} let sortedArray = array.toSorted((a, b) => a - b) if (upper) {sortedArray = sortedArray.reverse()} let numbersToChoose = Math.ceil((percentile / 100) * sortedArray.length) sortedArray = sortedArray.slice(0,numbersToChoose) return sortedArray.reduce((sum, x) => sum + x) / sortedArray.length } function addSpaces(baseStr: string, compareStr: string) { const difference = baseStr.length - compareStr.length if (difference < 0) { return " ".repeat(Math.abs(difference)) } return "" } const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms)) const app = express(); const serverLimit = 100 const serverBatchLimit = 10 const clientLimit = 10 const maxCommentsPerPost = 25 app.get("/api/posts", async (_req, res) => { try { console.log("Getting posts"); const posts: Post[] = [] let last: string | undefined; for (let i = 1; i <= serverBatchLimit; i++) { const nextPosts = await reddit.getNewPosts({ subredditName: "wallstreetbets", limit: serverLimit, pageSize: serverLimit, ...(last != undefined ? { after: last } : {}) }).all(); if (nextPosts.length > 0) { last = nextPosts[nextPosts.length -1]?.id } posts.push(...nextPosts) console.log(`ID: ${i} length: ${nextPosts.length} last: ${last}`) const prodeciProgress = Math.round((i/serverBatchLimit)*10) console.log(`|${"#".repeat(prodeciProgress)}${"-".repeat(10-prodeciProgress)}|`) } console.log("Getting post authors") let postAuthors: Record<string, User> = {}; const bigPostChunks = Array.from({ length: serverBatchLimit }, (_, i) => posts.slice(i*serverLimit, (i+1) * serverLimit)) for (let i = 0; i < serverBatchLimit; i++) { console.log(i+1, " out of ", serverBatchLimit) postAuthors = {...postAuthors , ...Object.fromEntries( await Promise.all( bigPostChunks[i].map( async post => [ post.authorId, await post.getAuthor() ])))} } const commentsSortedPosts = posts.filter(post => post.numberOfComments > 0) let comments: Comment[] = [] const commentChunkAmount = Math.ceil(commentsSortedPosts.length / (800/maxCommentsPerPost)) const chunkSize = Math.ceil(commentsSortedPosts.length / commentChunkAmount) let j = 0 const smallPostChunks = Array.from({ length: commentChunkAmount }, (_, i) => commentsSortedPosts.slice(i*chunkSize, (i+1) * chunkSize)) console.log(smallPostChunks) while (true) { try { console.log("Getting Comments. TIMOUT: 5 SECONDS") for ( let [k, postsChunk] of smallPostChunks.entries()) { let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>; if (j > k) {continue;} comments.push(...( await Promise.race([ Promise.all( postsChunk.map( async post => await post.comments.get(Math.min(post.numberOfComments, maxCommentsPerPost))) ), new Promise<Comment[][]>((resolve) => { console.log("TIMEOUT active!") timer = setTimeout(() => {console.log("TIMEOUT SKIPPING."); resolve([]);}, 5000); } ) ]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer)) ).flat()) j++ console.log(j, " out of ", commentChunkAmount) } console.log("succes") break } catch(error) { if (typeof error == "object" && error != null && "code" in error && (error.code == 8 || error.code == 7)) { console.log("Waiting 3 seconds. Rate limit exceeded.\n") for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) { await sleep(i*1000) console.log((3-i).toString() + "s remaining") } console.log("Resuming") continue } else { console.log("ERROR: ", error) break; } } } console.log("Sorting comments") for (let [i, comment] of comments.entries()) { if (i % (comments.length / 100) == 0) {console.log((((i+1) / comments.length)*100).toFixed(0)), "%"} if (comment.authorId == undefined) { comments.splice(i,1); continue; } if (comment.authorId in postAuthors) { comments.splice(i,1); continue; } } console.log("Getting comment authors") const commentAuthors: Record<string, User> = Object.fromEntries( await Promise.all( comments.map(async comment => [ comment.authorId, comment.getAuthor() ]))) const authors: Record<string, User> = {...commentAuthors, ...postAuthors} console.log("Looking for more posts") const numberOfAuthors = Object.keys(authors).length let authorProgress = 0 let succes = 0 let succesPosts = 0 let succesPostsArray: number[] = [] let postsById = new Set(posts.map(post => post.id)) await Promise.all( Object.entries(authors).map(async ([authorID, author]) => { authorProgress++ if (authorProgress % 100 == 0) {console.log("Author number: ", authorProgress, " out of ", numberOfAuthors, " ", ((authorProgress / numberOfAuthors) * 100).toFixed(2), "%")} let NewPosts: Post[] = [] if (!author) {return;} try { NewPosts = await reddit.getPostsByUser({username: author.username, limit: 1000, sort: "new"}).all() succes++ succesPosts += NewPosts.length succesPostsArray.push(NewPosts.length) } catch (error) { if (typeof error == "object" && error != null && "code" in error && (error.code == 5 || error.code == 7)) { return; } else { console.log("ERROR: ", error) return; } } if (NewPosts.length <= 1) {return;} for (let post of NewPosts) { if (postsById.has(post.id)) {continue;} if (post.subredditName != "wallstreetbets") {continue;} posts.push(post) postsById.add(post.id) } }) ) console.log("succes: ", succes, " / ", numberOfAuthors, " ", (succes/numberOfAuthors)*100, "% average posts: ", succesPosts/numberOfAuthors, "\nThe top 1% of posters post on average ", getTopAverage(succesPostsArray, 1, true), "posts") // Where all the fun happends const postsByUpvotes = posts.map((post) => ({upvotes: post.score, flair: post.flair?.text, comments: post.numberOfComments})) // Sorting const lossPostsByUpvotes = postsByUpvotes.filter(post => post.flair === "Loss") const gainPostsByUpvotes = postsByUpvotes.filter(post => post.flair === "Gain") // upvotes const averageLossUpvotes = lossPostsByUpvotes.reduce((sum, post) => sum + post.upvotes, 0) / lossPostsByUpvotes.length const averageGainUpvotes = gainPostsByUpvotes.reduce((sum, post) => sum + post.upvotes, 0) / gainPostsByUpvotes.length const averageUpvotes = posts.reduce((sum, post) => sum + post.score, 0) / posts.length // comments const averageLossComments = lossPostsByUpvotes.reduce((sum, post) => sum + post.comments, 0) / lossPostsByUpvotes.length const averageGainComments = gainPostsByUpvotes.reduce((sum, post) => sum + post.comments, 0) / gainPostsByUpvotes.length const averageComments = posts.reduce((sum, post) => sum + post.numberOfComments, 0) / posts.length // SIze const lossSize = lossPostsByUpvotes.length.toString(); const gainSize = gainPostsByUpvotes.length.toString(); const allSize = posts.length.toString(); const fixedData = { gain: { upvotes: averageGainUpvotes.toFixed(1), comments: averageGainComments.toFixed(1) }, loss: { upvotes: averageLossUpvotes.toFixed(1), comments: averageLossComments.toFixed(1) }, all: { upvotes: averageUpvotes.toFixed(1), comments: averageComments.toFixed(1) } } console.log(` | Loss | Comments ${addSpaces("Comments", fixedData.loss.comments)}| Score ${addSpaces("Score", fixedData.loss.upvotes)}| Size ${addSpaces("Size", lossSize)}| |======| ${fixedData.loss.comments + addSpaces(fixedData.loss.comments, "Comments")} | ${fixedData.loss.upvotes + addSpaces(fixedData.loss.upvotes, "Score")} | ${lossSize + addSpaces(lossSize, "Size")} | | Gain | Comments ${addSpaces("Comments", fixedData.gain.comments)}| Score ${addSpaces("Score", fixedData.gain.upvotes)}| Size ${addSpaces("Size", gainSize)}| |======| ${fixedData.gain.comments + addSpaces(fixedData.gain.comments, "Comments")} | ${fixedData.gain.upvotes + addSpaces(fixedData.gain.upvotes, "Score")} | ${gainSize + addSpaces(gainSize, "Size")} | | All | Comments ${addSpaces("Comments", fixedData.all.comments)}| Score ${addSpaces("Score", fixedData.all.upvotes)}| Size ${addSpaces("Size", allSize)}| |======| ${fixedData.all.comments + addSpaces(fixedData.all.comments, "Comments")} | ${fixedData.all.upvotes + addSpaces(fixedData.all.upvotes, "Score")} | ${allSize + addSpaces(allSize, "Size")} |`) res.json( posts.slice(0,clientLimit).map((post) => ({ title: post.title, url: post.url, score: post.score, comments: post.numberOfComments, galleries: post.gallery, flair: post.flair?.text })) ); } catch (error) { console.error("Error fetching posts:", error); res.status(500).json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error), }); } }); const server = createServer(app); server.on("error", (error) => { console.error("Server error:", error); }); server.listen(getServerPort(), () => { console.log("Server started"); }); To run the app you must install reddit devvit from developers.reddit.com and create a tool. Then call the backend with: const response = await fetch("/api/posts"); in the frontend.
